Harbour notices

Checked every morning by the harbour office

The notices below cover the quay, the slipway and the ferry steps. Each one says who to ask when something on it is not clear, and when it was last read through by the office.

Slipway closed for repairs

Monday 4 to Friday 8 March

The slipway is shut while the concrete at its foot is relaid. Small boats can be launched from the beach beside the sailing club for the whole week, at any state of the tide.

Ferry steps

Handrail fitted on both sides

The steps down to the ferry now have a rail on each side and a landing halfway. The lower steps are still slippery at low water, so the crew will help anyone who asks.
